description: This 2026 Chevrolet Tahoe High Country represents the pinnacle of full-size SUV capability, engineered to deliver both refined comfort and commanding presence on any road.  - Panoramic power sunroof with dual-pane design - Air Ride Adaptive suspension with Magnetic Ride Control - Max Trailering Package with Integrated Trailer Brake Controller - Bose 10-Speaker Centerpoint Surround Audio System - Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium with Google built-in compatibility - 15-inch diagonal Head-Up Display - Power-retractable assist steps with perimeter lighting - 22-inch 6-spoke low gloss black wheels with machined accents - Driver and front passenger heated and ventilated seats - 8-way power driver and passenger seat adjusters with 4-way lumbar support - Super Cruise hands-free driving technology - Remote start with key card access - Wireless phone charging - SiriusXM with 360L trial subscription - Hill Descent Control and Blind Zone Steering Assist with Trailering  The EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission delivers the performance and reliability you expect from a premium full-size SUV. The 4WD system with 2-speed Active Electronic AutoTrac transfer case ensures confident handling across diverse driving conditions.  The High Country trim elevates your driving experience with heated and ventilated front seats, a heated steering wheel, and a power rear liftgate that operates seamlessly. The three-row seating configuration accommodates passengers with generous comfort, while the third-row power-folding split-bench seat maximizes cargo flexibility. Memory seat settings allow multiple drivers to enjoy personalized positioning automatically.  Advanced safety technology is integrated throughout this vehicle. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags protect occupants, while electronic stability control, traction control, and speed-sensing steering enhance vehicle dynamics. The exterior camera and Hitch View with pan/zoom image adjustment provide clear visibility for parking and trailering.  Climate control extends throughout the cabin with automatic temperature management, front dual-zone air conditioning, rear air conditioning, and a rear window defroster. The auto-leveling suspension automatically adjusts ride height to maintain comfort regardless of load, while the extra capacity cooling system ensures consistent performance even during demanding drives.  This Gray Tahoe High Country combines luxury appointments with serious capability. With just 9,219 miles, this vehicle provides the confidence of low mileage paired with the advanced features and technology that define the High Country experience. The 22-inch machined aluminum wheels and bright front and rear door sill plates reflect the attention to detail throughout this premium offering.
